info.title: DataProvider
info.description: Unified DataProvider codegen tool. Generates type-safe data access code for Postgres, SQLite, and SqlServer from live database schemas.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: DataProvider codegen tool. Generates type-safe data access code from a live database. Pick a platform subcommand: postgres | sqlite.

commands.name: postgres
commands.description: Generate type-safe PostgreSQL data access code

options.name: --project-dir
options.description: Project directory containing sql files and DataProvider.json

options.name: --offline
options.description: Run in offline mode without database connection (uses schema.yaml for metadata)

options.name: --schema
options.description: Path to schema.yaml file (required for offline mode)

commands.name: sqlite
commands.description: Generate type-safe SQLite data access code

options.name: --project-dir
options.description: Project directory containing sql, grouping, and DataProvider.json

options.name: --connection-type
options.description: Database connection type for generated code (e.g., SqliteConnection, NpgsqlConnection)
